reviewer: Codex documentary-photo visual, attribution and exact-file licensing review (AI-assisted)
method: Read Commons image descriptions, geographic context and file-specific licensing metadata; fetched each exact file page sequentially with normal pacing, then read its file-specific permission template (not merely generic page-footer licenses). Retained source/download hashes and rehashed every served WebP. Visually inspected all 120 final optimized images in six 20-image contact sheets, matched individual locations and corrected bilingual archive captions. Each visual approval is bound to the exact image SHA-256.
findings: All 120 photographs depict their assigned place, an expressly identified viewpoint from it, or its documented Christmas decorations; no illustrations or generated images were used.
Twelve exact-place photographs reuse already licensed WebP bytes under new seasonal IDs; all corresponding base/variant hashes were checked again and their exact Commons rights pages revisited.
Replaced an abstract Tivoli red-light result with identifiable decorated market cabins; replaced an isolated Via del Corso wire decoration with a wider elevated street view.
Rejected homonymous Madrid Puerta del Sol photos for Vigo, unrelated San Francisco/Birkenhead results for Skansen, drawings, scans, under-size sources and summer Tollwood results from another site.
Every photograph has Spanish and English archive wording; historical market scenes and summer landmarks are not presented as the 2026 decorations.

Brussels Marché aux Poissons nominal January timestamp conflicted with full foliage, so its caption omits the disputed season/date. Europaplatz is explicitly an October 2022 Ferris-wheel archive, not a Christmas installation.
Bruges Simon Stevinplein is a genuine stitched photographic panorama, identified as such.

The Central Park image has a file-specific public-domain declaration for a National Park Service employee work (HAER NY-194-7); its page lacks a generic Public Domain Mark URL, recorded honestly as rightsStatementFound rather than licenseLinkFound.
Belvedere source retouching by Julia W was identified on the exact file page and added alongside photographer Murdockcrc in credit and modification details.
Old Montreal photographer Jason Thibault requests a Massive Kontent backlink; attributionUrl records the exact author URL for rendered credits.

Explicit Berlin and Cologne author-site attribution links and four Geograph work titles are preserved. Zurich source names Adrian Michael as author and Parpan05 in the license attribution template; both names are retained with the discrepancy documented in evidence.
No rate limit was encountered; no alternate proxy, quota bypass, paid API or invented permission was used.
There are no unreferenced xmas WebP derivatives.
